name: Eligibility 509.2 — Contract Not In Effect for Group (Deny) Navigator

steps.hint: Click the 'Event Resolution' tab. The active PX_509 edit ('Contract not in effect for the selected group for billed dates of service') is highlighted in red.
steps.name: Identify the PX_509 hard edit
steps.description: Navigate to the Event Resolution tab. All applicable edits for the claim will be displayed here. A hard-edit card for Event PX_509 will be highlighted with an error indication. This is the current event you need to resolve.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes as soon as the trainee opens the Event Resolution tab.

steps.hint: Open the 'Member Info' tab. Note all seven highlighted identity fields — First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, DOB, Sex, Group ID, and Member Prefix — you'll cross-check them on the Claim Image next.
steps.name: Review member identity fields
steps.description: Open the Member Information tab and review the seven identity fields: First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Sex, Group ID, and Member Prefix. These fields will be cross-checked against the Claim Image in the next step.
steps.checklistItem: Seven identity fields noted on Member Info
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member Information tab to review the seven identity fields.

steps.hint: Click the 'Claim Image' tab. Compare the seven highlighted identity fields against what you noted on Member Info — all seven match here.
steps.name: Cross-check member fields against the Claim Image
steps.description: Open the Claim Image tab and verify that the seven identity fields — First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Sex, Group ID, and Member Prefix — match the values you noted on the Member Information tab exactly. All seven match in this scenario.
steps.checklistItem: Claim Image identity fields verified against Member Info
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Image tab to cross-check the seven identity fields against Member Info.

steps.hint: Click 'Search', then the 'Member' sub-tab. Business Unit reads 'Small Group' here — note Group ID, Prefix, Effective Date, and Termination Date.
steps.name: Look up the contract on Search
steps.description: Navigate to the Search tab, select the Member sub-tab, and open the Member General Information section. Review the Business Unit field to determine the contract type. The available Business Unit values are Large Group, Small Group, and Individual. Large Group cases should be handled according to the dedicated SOP-defined process, while Small Group and Individual follow the standard shared process.  Here it reads 'Small Group', so record the Group ID, Member Prefix, Effective Date, and Termination Date.
steps.checklistItem: Look up the contract on Search
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member sub-tab inside Search. The 'Search member' action also completes this step.

steps.hint: Return to Member Info, then click Group ID and Member Prefix to mark them reviewed. Both match the Search → Member panel.
steps.name: Confirm Group ID and Prefix
steps.description: Confirm that the Group ID and Member Prefix on the Search tab (Member sub-tab) align with the values on the Member Information tab. The Group ID and Member Prefix match in this case.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member Information tab to confirm the Group ID and Member Prefix.

steps.hint: Open 'Claim Lines'. Both lines' From / To dates fall outside the keyed group's Effective – Termination window — head back to Search → Member to see whether any other group is active and effective.
steps.name: Check service dates against coverage range
steps.description: Check that the 'From' and 'To' dates on the Claim Lines tab fall within the Effective Date and End Date range on the Member sub-tab. If the claim is keyed under the correct active Group ID, follow the alternate SOP steps; if not, proceed. In this scenario, there are two claim lines, and neither falls within the Effective Date and End Date range of the selected group on the Member sub-tab of the Search tab. You will need to check whether a different group exists that is both active and effective.
steps.checklistItem: Check service dates against coverage range
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes on first visit to Claim Lines tab.

steps.hint: On Search → Member, scroll to the alternate group section. Click the Effective Date and Termination Date cells — confirm neither covers the claim line service dates.
steps.name: Verify no active alternate group exists
steps.description: Navigate to the Search tab, then the Member sub-tab to review the alternate group on the Member sub-tab and determine whether any other contract group is both active and effective for the service dates on the claim. In this scenario, two contract groups are listed, but neither has an Effective Date and End Date range that covers the service dates on the claim lines, so a Reject code must be applied.
steps.checklistItem: Verify no active alternate group exists
steps.completionTriggerNote: Trainee must focus BOTH the alternate group's Effective Date and Termination Date cells to confirm neither covers the claim service dates. Visit-triggers won't fire if the trainee is already on Search → Member from step 3, so we require explicit field focus.

steps.hint: Action menu → Deny Claim. Enter reject code PX_R01030 in the Deny Claim section, click Submit, then confirm the pop-up.
steps.name: Deny the claim using a reject code
steps.description: To deny the claim, select Deny Claim from the Action menu. A Deny Claim section appears below the header. Enter the appropriate reject code based on the coverage review: PX_R01030 — date of service is after the member's coverage termination date; PX_R11260 — date of service is before the membership effective date; PX_R11310 — denial is coverage-dependent. In this scenario, the date of service falls after the coverage termination date. Enter PX_R01030 in the Deny Claim section and click Submit.
steps.checklistItem: Deny the claim using Reject code PX_R01030
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee submits the Deny Claim panel (which dispatches the deny_claim action).

steps.hint: Click the Submit button to finalize the Deny decision.
steps.name: Submit Deny decision
steps.description: After confirming the Deny Claim panel, click the Submit button to finalize the Deny decision and complete the attempt.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee submits the Deny decision with the Submit button.

description: Resolve Edit PX_509 when neither the keyed group nor the alternate group covers the claim line service dates: verify member identity, look up the contract on Search → Member, confirm Group ID / Prefix on Member Info, check service dates against the keyed group's range, return to Search to confirm no alternate covers, open Action menu → Deny Claim, enter reject code PX_R01030, submit Deny.

stepSummaryForResults.name: Seven identity fields noted on Member Info
Business Unit = Small Group; contract looked up
Both claim lines out of window
Deny Claim panel submitted with PX_R01030
